title: US prepares new tariffs on China, the EU, Japan and 13 other trading partners
caption:
The United States is preparing new tariffs on 16 trading partners, including China, the European Union, Japan, India and South Korea, Reuters and Politico report. They follow investigations into excess industrial capacity, opened after the Supreme Court struck down President Trump's global tariffs in February. Rates have not been announced, and public comments and hearings are required before any new duties take effect.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
